_about: SPEC §6.7.6 LINKIDENTIFY body, generated from upstream Python RNS. The initiator identity and link_id are the SAME pinned values used by reticulum-specifications test-vectors/identities.json (label 'alice') and test-vectors/links.json (vector 'alice_to_bob_aes256cbc'), so this vector chains onto the existing handshake vector: alice is that handshake's initiator, and LINKIDENTIFY is initiator-emitted. Ed25519 is RFC 8032 deterministic, so the signature is reproducible from the pinned private key.
generator: upstream RNS Identity.sign(), mirroring RNS/Link.py identify()
_trap: signature_over_link_id_only_hex is what an implementation produces if it signs link_id instead of link_id||public_key. §6.7.6 calls this out explicitly; a conforming verifier MUST reject it.
